details: As of today, when in a given world on game start world audio will work fine.  If the world audio url is changed I will no longer be able to get world audio in that particular world until I restart the game.  Have tested rejoin, resync, toggling untrusted urls, going to another world and returning.
title: World audio failure on url change.
